{{Short description|Logic-based number puzzle using greater-than and less-than symbols}}
[[Image:Mainarizumu.png|A 5x5 Mainarizumu puzzle|thumb]]
'''Mainarizumu''' (マイナリズム), also known as '''Minarism''', is a type of [[logic puzzle]] published by [[Nikoli (publisher)|Nikoli]].

==Rules==
''Mainarizumu'' is played on a square grid, typically 7x7 or smaller, with two kinds of clues: a greater-than or less-than sign connecting two adjacent squares, or a circled digit connecting two adjacent squares. The solver is to enter a digit into every square so that:
* No digit is repeated in any row or column (much like in [[Sudoku]] puzzles).<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://indi.s58.xrea.com/minarism/|title=連続発破保管庫 マイナリズム編|website=indi.s58.xrea.com|access-date=2018-05-08}}</ref>
* If two squares are connected by a greater-than or less-than sign, then the digits in those squares must obey that inequality.<ref name=":0" />
* If two squares are connected by a circled digit, then the digits in those squares must differ by exactly that amount.<ref name=":0" />
